title: Home: the local group card names the place only
why: Jason's screenshots, 2026-11-19: the home page's local group card read "Ancient America · region you came from neighbors". The home page copied the header menu's display text for the place, which adds where the place came from (" · region you came from", " · your default"); the Where field cut that off, the group card did not. Both now use the place's own name (location-scope.js's tvPlaceLabel), so the card reads "Ancient America neighbors".
